help.title: Just a gentle turn.
help.step1: Find an outside ring: it touches only one other ring.
help.step2: Drag around its center to rotate the opening toward its neighbor. Release your finger when it aligns.
help.step3: Clear the loose ends to reach the rings in the middle. Tap the final free ring to finish.
help.copy:
Prefer buttons? Select a ring, use ‹ ›, then Let go.
Keyboard: ↑ ↓ select, ← → turn, Enter releases.
Three stars: no hints and at most two extra moves. Undo counts as a move. Hints never cost money.
